title: Reading Drill — Tracking damage to borrowed instruments — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Tracking damage to borrowed instruments — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Hillswick began with reports of minor defects being discovered only before a lesson. The school music technician had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using inspection cards and chose reported damage per loan as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was checks at the return desk. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted eight weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded the age of each instrument as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
